Sandbox_Preservative_PreservationStrengt: 0%% follows the player's Food Spoilage setting; default 40%%; 100%% completely stops spoilage inside the preservative's protection range.
Sandbox_Preservative_GlobalPreservation_: 0%% makes perishable food rot immediately; 50%% follows the save's Food Spoilage setting; 100%% prevents all food spoilage worldwide.
Sandbox_Preservative_BottleLifetimeDays_: Range: 1–9999999 days; default: 30. Time is consumed only while perishable food is actually protected.
Sandbox_Preservative_SpawnMultiplier_too: 0× disables spawns; 1× is the base rate; default is 5×; maximum is 100×.
Sandbox_Preservative_WorksInColdStorage_: Allows additional preservative protection in refrigerators and freezers, consuming lifetime only while protection is active.
Sandbox_Preservative_EatingCausesPoisoni: When enabled, consuming any amount starts treatable lethal poisoning. When disabled, this mod applies no poisoning effect.
Sandbox_Preservative_LethalDelayHours_to: Default: 6 hours; range: 0.25–24. Use Lemongrass or Antibiotics before the countdown ends.
Sandbox_Preservative_ShowPoisonIndicator: All-poison status icon and treatment guidance
Shows preservative, food-sickness, and general-poison states. Known antidotes are shown; otherwise the tooltip gives source-appropriate guidance.
